endorsements.quote: It is essential to ensure that these models comply with stringent privacy regulations, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) in the United States and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in the European Union [ 5 ].
ML models should also be trained and validated on diverse, representative datasets to ensure the accuracy and fairness of their predictions.

unlisted_practices: AI systems should provide explanations for their predictions or recommendations to help healthcare providers make informed decisions.
Fully inform patients about AI involvement in their care and respect patient autonomy and informed consent when using LLMs in healthcare.
Create accessible and user-friendly interfaces for LLMs and educate the public about AI.
Continue research and development to minimize biases in LLMs and promote fairness so healthcare solutions are equitable for all.

screen.reason: Editorial discussing the integration, potential benefits, and governance/ethical challenges (privacy, security, bias) of large language models in EHR systems.
